item.title: 【Off-Topic】ADM NITROCELL
item.description: Getting demoted and not even being able to change my username in 30 days is a shame. That’s the price for telling it like it is, the truth and asking for improvements. I’ve helped out for years, since 2014, just to not even be able to change my username. 170 days really? Everything I did to help Sharemania boiled down to dust. At least I should be able to keep changing my username in 30 days; it's the bare minimum. Thanks for everything @nitrocell
item.author: DETOX
